name: instances
view_definition:
SELECT starts.tenant_id,
    starts.environment_id,
    starts.owner,
    starts.submission_id,
    starts.instance_id,
    starts.flow_head,
    starts.flow_version,
    starts.instance_id AS root_instance_id
   FROM cp6_approval_start_v2.starts
UNION ALL
 SELECT c.tenant_id,
    c.environment_id,
    s.owner,
    s.submission_id,
    c.instance_id,
    c.flow_head,
    c.flow_version,
    c.root_instance_id
   FROM cp6_approval_runtime_v2.children c
     JOIN cp6_approval_start_v2.starts s ON s.instance_id = c.root_instance_id AND s.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND s.environment_id = c.environment_id;

    WHEN "RequestJson" IS NULL THEN NULL::boolean
    ELSE "RequestJson"::text IS JSON OBJECT OR "RequestJson"::text IS JSON ARRAY
